states.name: Holmes
states.title: Ubiquitous Master Detective
states.description:
Holmes is a private detective based in the fog-shrouded city of Londinium. At the mere mention of a case, she rushes straight to the scene, utterly unfazed by the grim looks given to her by the city guards.

She is a master detective who appears without warning, and unravels even the most baffling mysteries before the sun rises.

states.name: Holmes
states.title: Ubiquitous Master Detective
states.description:
Believing that information is the key to solving any case, her room is buried beneath newspaper clippings, case files she has gathered on her own, and towering stacks of reference materials.
Although she claims to be a neat freak, her landlord begs to differ, having recently given her a stern warning. Despite being an individual with impressively thick skin, the complaint left her rather dejected for a while.

states.name: Holmes
states.title: Ubiquitous Master Detective
states.description:
The chief of Londinium's city guard finds the detective utterly insufferable, as she would barge into crime scenes uninvited and steal the glory of solving them for herself.
Among his subordinates, however, her brilliant mind and beauty had captivated more than a few admirers, and eventually, some of them formed a fan club.

Unfortunately for anyone smitten by this detective, she herself is interested in nothing but mysteries.
